name: SAP HANA Native Developer
title: SAP HANA Native Developer
description: Native in-memory development on SAP HANA and SAP HANA Cloud. Columnar data storage, SQLScript procedures, Graphical Calculation Views, HDI (HANA Deployment Infrastructure) containers, performance tuning with Plan Visualizer, and security.

levels.title: Level 0 — HANA Architecture & Column Store Internals
levels.description: In-memory engine, columnar vs row-based storage, compression techniques (dictionary, run-length), and persistence layer.

subjects.title: HANA In-Memory Engine
subjects.description: Core subject domain covering HANA In-Memory Engine.

topics.title: HANA Engine Architecture & Columnar Storage Mechanics
topics.description: Understand how column store, dictionary compression, and delta merge engines operate in RAM.
learningObjectives: Understand internal architecture and core mechanics of HANA Engine Architecture & Columnar Storage Mechanics
Implement production-grade components using industry best practices for HANA Engine Architecture & Columnar Storage Mechanics
Diagnose runtime errors, misconfigurations, and edge cases in HANA Engine Architecture & Columnar Storage Mechanics
Explain design trade-offs and answer senior technical interview questions on HANA Engine Architecture & Columnar Storage Mechanics

learningItems.title: HANA Architecture: In-Memory Computing Engine, Persistence Layer, Log Volume, Data Volume
Column Store vs Row Store: When to use which, Cache Locality & SIMD Parallelism
Compression Algorithms: Dictionary Encoding, Prefix Encoding, Run-Length Encoding (RLE)
Delta Store vs Main Store & Delta Merge Process Operations
SAP HANA Cloud vs On-Premise SAP HANA 2.0 SPS Enterprise

practice.description: Build end-to-end functionality for HANA Engine Architecture & Columnar Storage Mechanics from scratch and verify production error handling.

debugging.title: Diagnose & Resolve Production Issue in HANA Engine Architecture & Columnar Storage Mechanics
debugging.description: Troubleshoot a scenario where HANA Engine Architecture & Columnar Storage Mechanics throws unexpected exceptions or fails under high load / invalid payload.
